title: TEST 2 -- Does accuracy depend on acausal (out-of-cone) information?
design: Causal-masking: for each target, set all input outside the 6h physical cone to climatology, re-run one step, measure forecast degradation at the target. A causal model is invariant (causal floor = 0); reliance on out-of-cone input shows up as degradation.

synthetic_control.pde: 1D advection, exact step = roll-by-1, EXACT ground truth, zero solver leakage
synthetic_control.interpretation: At the physical cone radius (=CNN receptive radius), masking physically-forbidden input degrades the FNO one-step skill by ~415x (3.2e-04 -> 1.3e-01, i.e. RMSE jumps to ~13% of field std) while leaving the CNN EXACTLY unchanged (5.5e-04 -> 5.5e-04). The FNO needs out-of-cone input to be accurate; the causal CNN does not. Robust across zero / in-cone-mean / periodic-extend fills (CNN identical to 1e-12 in all).
synthetic_control.ood_J24_caveat: OOD, the FNO is already broken (full RMSE 0.40) so masking adds little; the clean dependence signal is in-distribution where the FNO is otherwise highly accurate.

real_model_fourcastnet.metric: No external +6h ERA5 truth in cache, so we measure forecast CHANGE at target from masking out-of-cone input (necessary condition for skill-reliance) + remote-only reconstruction. Numerical control = 0 exactly.
real_model_fourcastnet.confound_honest: Masking 97%% of the globe to flat climatology is itself a large out-of-distribution input, so the absolute delta_T magnitude is inflated by OOD-input shock, not purely by needed information. The clean causal contrast is the synthetic CNN, which is provably immune to ANY out-of-cone input change (delta=0). The remote-only reconstruction (~80%%) is the cleaner real-model evidence: the +6h target forecast is largely reproducible from PURELY forbidden remote input.

verdict.headline: ACCURACY DEPENDS ON ACAUSAL INFORMATION (architecture-class result). In the exact-truth synthetic, masking physically-forbidden out-of-cone input degrades the leaky FNO one-step skill by ~415x while leaving the causal CNN EXACTLY unchanged -- the FNO BUILDS its accuracy on out-of-cone shortcuts; the CNN does not need them. On the real deployed FourCastNet the same masking changes the +6h target forecast by a median 6.6 K (2.8x the global t2m wRMSE) and a remote-only input reconstructs ~80% of the target forecast signal -- consistent with genuine reliance on forbidden remote information (magnitude inflated by OOD-input shock; the clean causal floor is the CNN). This is a concrete WHY-IT-IS-WRONG: the accuracy is partly a spurious non-local shortcut that has no causal basis and will not generalize where those correlations break.
